hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *git\ commit*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; fmt=$(yarn prettier --check "**/*.{ts,tsx,md,json,css}" 2>&1) || { echo "PRE-COMMIT 阻止: prettier 格式检查未通过。请运行 yarn format，然后重新 add 并重试 commit。详情:" >&2; echo "$fmt" >&2; exit 2; }; lint=$(yarn lint 2>&1) || { echo "PRE-COMMIT 阻止: eslint 检查未通过 (--max-warnings 0)。请修复错误后重试 commit。详情:" >&2; echo "$lint" >&2; exit 2; }
